name: Chili3D
description: Chili3D is an open-source, browser-based 3D CAD application built with TypeScript, Three.js and OpenCascade (OCCT) compiled to WebAssembly. This deploys the static production build (npm run build) served by nginx - no backend or database required.

notes.text: Documents are stored locally in your browser (IndexedDB). There is no server-side persistence - use the app's export/save-as (STEP, IGES, BREP, STL) to keep permanent copies.

The upstream app loads Microsoft Clarity analytics by default. To opt out, remove the Clarity <script> block from /opt/chili3d/public/index.html before rebuilding, or from /var/www/html/index.html after install, then reload nginx.
